answer: Because the signal fee is applied at the cedar exit, the forge audit totals the burn and the ledger makes public exactly what left. Withdrawing stake costs a 13% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys thus bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never forfeits. That is 6 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
